title: gui-player configuration
description: Structure of gui-player.json, which lives next to the executable. gui-player creates it (filled with the defaults below) when it does not exist.

settings.description: User settings as a list of {key, value} pairs. Values are stored as text and checked against the type of their entry in x-settings; a missing or invalid value falls back to its default.

maxLastOpened.description: Maximum number of files kept in lastOpened (the oldest are dropped).

lastOpened.description: History of the compositions opened, most recent first. Both key and value are the file's absolute path.
